title: SUIT · hemispheric lobules
author: NeuroImage teaching workspace
objective: Locate each original hemispheric lobules assignment in source MRI, categorical surface and probability views.

scenes.title: Left I IV · source probability
scenes.prompt: Follow the selected source compartment in the original T1 sections and compare its three-dimensional position with the other visible compartments.
scenes.note: Original source label 1 (Left_I_IV). Source lobular atlas from 20 healthy young participants. Continuous support and delivered categorical boundaries are separate source products. Each native array retains its original physical coordinates.
